usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all configured authentication realms (e.g., 'pve', 'pam', LDAP/AD, OpenID) available on the cluster. No authentication is required — Proxmox intentionally exposes this endpoint publicly so login UIs can populate the realm dropdown before a user authenticates. Results include the realm ID, type, optional comment, and whether a legacy TFA provider (yubico or oath) is configured.

examples.summary: List all authentication domains on the cluster

tips: The 'tfa' field only appears for realms using the older yubico/oath TFA providers; modern TOTP/WebAuthn TFA configured via the user TFA API will not show here.
Realm names returned here are the values to pass as the 'realm' parameter when authenticating via POST /access/ticket.
The built-in 'pam' (Linux PAM) and 'pve' (Proxmox internal) realms are always present.
